scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Sum of256 products, separate FP64 FP32 FP16 BF16 device-result dot operations
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Original abs<0.1 versus native float-product CPU sum retained for each dtype; every output exact across both GPU references for named fixture.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: FP16/BF16 quantization and low-precision output rounding are intrinsic to native operation; no arbitrary-input conditioning claim.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Inner products in iterative numerical solvers, projection and machine-learning linear algebra; domain-neutral linear algebra with illustrative uses.
scientific_intent.description: The full native dot operation is retained in four storage/output precisions, including real BF16. Low-precision inputs accumulate in Float32 before rounding the scalar result, while Float64 accumulates in Float64.
scientific_intent.provenance: Native blas-dot main.cu defines allfour types, inputconstant and validation; hardware support established by successful nativeBF16probe and allfive four-model trials.
